title: Dashboard
caption: Hours this week, open work orders, finished work that is not billed yet, and PTO waiting on an answer.

desktop.alt: Sample desktop dashboard for fictional Sample Contracting. Stats show 66.5 hours this week, 6 open work orders, 2 jobs not billed, and 1 PTO request waiting. The crew list names Alex Rivera, Jordan Blake, Sam Patel, Casey Nguyen, and Riley Chen on sample jobs.

phone.alt: Sample phone dashboard for fictional Sample Contracting, showing 66.5 hours this week, 6 open work orders, 2 unbilled jobs, and 1 PTO request waiting.

title: Time entry
caption: Employees clock time to a job and a work order. The same entry is on the phone and on a desktop.

desktop.alt: Sample desktop time screen. Alex Rivera is on the clock at North Warehouse on work order WO-2041 since 6:58 AM, with 6.5 hours today.

phone.alt: Sample phone time entry. Alex Rivera is clocked in on work order WO-2041 at North Warehouse, with a button to clock out.

title: Work order
caption: A scheduled work order shows the site, the crew, the scope, and the hours logged against it.

desktop.alt: Sample work order WO-2041 for Sample Warehouse Co. at 400 North Yard. Status is in progress. The scope is 24 Cat6 drops. Alex Rivera and Jordan Blake are assigned.

phone.alt: Sample phone view of work order WO-2041, in progress, scheduled Tuesday November 3 at 7:00 AM for Alex Rivera and Jordan Blake.

title: PTO
caption: Requests and hour balances. No pay rates on this screen.

desktop.alt: Sample PTO screen. Riley Chen has a pending vacation request for November 26 and 27. Sam Patel's December 24 to 26 request is approved. Balances are listed in hours.

phone.alt: Sample phone PTO screen with Riley Chen's pending November request and hour balances for the fictional crew.

title: Billing
caption: Completed work stays on the list until it is billed. The report is hours, not someone's pay.

desktop.alt: Sample billing report. Work orders WO-1988 and WO-2010 are completed and not billed. WO-1902 is billed. The columns are hours, not pay rates.

phone.alt: Sample phone billing list. WO-1988 and WO-2010 are not billed. WO-1902 is billed. Totals are in hours.

title: Weekly summary
caption: Last week's hours by person, with PTO split out, marked ready for payroll.

desktop.alt: Sample weekly summary for October 26 to November 1. Five fictional employees, daily hours, 190 hours worked, 8 hours PTO, 198 hours ready for payroll.

phone.alt: Sample phone weekly summary for October 26 to November 1, with each fictional employee's week total and a ready-for-payroll status of 198 hours.
